verdict.rationale: Otter documents a Public API/Webhooks (Pro+ tier) and a hosted MCP server for querying meeting transcripts, summaries and action items (otter-docs-26/40/46, otter-probe-rt-1 confirms the MCP endpoint is live and OAuth-gated), but these are limited to read/query-style meeting-data access and are gated to paid/Enterprise workspaces rather than exposing full UI parity (recording controls, collaborative editing, CRM/ticket integrations, admin/security settings) as callable API operations, and no public OpenAPI/reference spec was found (otter-probe-1 all 404). Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for non-meeting-data UI actions (recording management, collaborative editing, integration configuration), a public API reference/spec, and availability outside Enterprise tier.
